verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs mention general permission management/ACLs and an API for building custom workflows, which implies some capability to control access, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of fine-grained/scoped personal access tokens or least-privilege credential issuance for agent use. Missing for 10: explicit docs on scoped API token creation, granular permission scopes for tokens, and any hands-on confirmation that an agent can be issued a least-privilege credential.
